concept_decisions: Concept six-rayed end view is useful but whole spindle looks like a seed pod and too smoothly closed. Build six thin radial bilaminar vanes with open longitudinal recesses between, broad oblique primary ribs nested secondary relief physically integrated in vane faces, not a solid capsule or modern feather/tentacles. Modest uneven edge and fossil brown artistic palette. Lie long axis horizontally as display orientation only, no rooted living posture.
